Date+theme-identified review/organization/planning pass per decision pm-zeifd2 (never sequentially numbered), successor to closed pass pm-e9yevx. Full all-status inspection of the 2,127-item workspace; live verification of release automation, npm/bun publish state, and CI; recorded brainstorms for CLI grammar simplification (pm-n7rr), token-efficient output (pm-g3n00m/pm-5t33or), adaptive context algorithms (pm-4k6b), SDK-first completeness (pm-usfg), immutable history (pm-w7ccmv), and multi-agent scale (pm-dj98/pm-9rxu); dedupe-checked gap filing; typed-edge enrichment so the all-status graph stays traversable to outcome milestones with explainable paths (pm-bzmeaa invariant).

Agents and humans can traverse from any active work to the outcome it serves; brainstorm output is preserved as tracker knowledge instead of chat ephemera

value.author: harness:opencode
value.text: Review-pass economics: on a mature tracker the highest-value moves are compositional, not additive. This pass filed exactly one new item (pm-rbg1qo) because search-first duplicate checking against 2,127 items showed the CLI-simplification, token-efficiency, scale, immutability, multi-agent and CI themes were all already owned; the genuine work was wiring — a 14-node supersedes chain across every historical review pass, implements/verifies anchors for the six items that lacked them, blocked_by completion of the outcome-milestone DAG, and composition maps (RL entitlement, warm token loop) recorded on the stories that bind the primitives. A pass that creates many items on a mature map is usually a sign the search step was skipped.
